newMessages.content: Task: Write a welcome message for new students. Write at length and be warm.

content.text:
Welcome to our school. We are truly glad you are here.

Starting something new can feel exciting and a little overwhelming, and both feelings are normal. Whether this is your first day or your first year, you now belong to a community of learners, teachers, and staff who want to see you succeed.

Here is what we hope you will find in your time with us:

**Support.** Teachers, counselors, and classmates are all ready to help. Asking a question is a sign of curiosity, not weakness. Please ask early and often.

**Curiosity.** Try subjects you have never studied, join a club, or take part in an activity you have never tried. Some of the most meaningful discoveries happen outside your comfort zone.

**Friendship.** You will meet people who share your interests and some who will surprise you. Be kind to others, and let them be kind to you in return.

**Patience.** You will make mistakes, and that is part of learning. Each mistake shows you where to grow next.

In your first few weeks, take time to find your way around the building, learn your schedule, and introduce yourself to someone new each day. Do not worry about getting everything right immediately. Everyone here was once new, too.

We look forward to getting to know you and to seeing what you will accomplish. Your story here is only beginning, and we are honored to be part of it.

Welcome aboard.
